verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly left to right with the headline on a single line and the CTA on the right. But the legal fine print has been promoted to a subhead, the can is tiny, the tilted sale banner floats in the middle with no relation to anything, and the SOLSTICE logo is a near-invisible speck jammed in the top-right corner. B is worse: the sale banner is pushed off the left edge, the headline wraps and leaves 'longer' orphaned on its own line, the legal text wraps into a cramped block under it, and the logo is an illegible speck tucked under a minuscule can, so the centre turns into a cluttered heap.
